question: Can the already causal L9H1/H4/H7 upstream response be translated through attention11 value weights into the same eight H3 coordinates whose downstream weight reader predicts behavior?

authority.l9_status: On sealed v8, removing L9H1/H4/H7 accounts for 99.51%/100.49% of complete L9-induced H3 response removal with <=2.97% complement.

frozen_design.population: All 31 A1 and 32 A2 jointly capable sealed v10 rows.
frozen_design.causal_contrast: Under the live L8H1 cue-to-subject writer, dynamically restore L9H1/H4/H7 subject-position head outputs to base and compare with the unclamped writer response at H3.
frozen_design.weight_writer: At the answer query, contract the exact subject-position normalized-state changes with H3's rows of attention11.c_v.weight, the unchanged initial-value cancellation factor (1-lamb), the clamped-base H3 attention pattern, and Q8. This yields eight predicted H3 coordinates. Pattern-change and pattern-value interaction remain explicit exact residual terms.
frozen_design.behavioral_contraction: Contract the predicted upstream coordinates with the already specified final eight-coordinate analytic reader to predict the L9-triple-mediated margin effect; no fitted scalar or task loss is allowed.

predictions.pred_a_authority_exact_capture_clamp_cov: Hashes, native identities, attention reconstruction, self-clamp, finite complete coverage, and price pass.
predictions.pred_b_l9_triple_removes_material_rank8_: The L9 triple removes at least 80% of the live-writer H3 Q8 coefficient-vector norm on average in both panels.
predictions.pred_c_value_weight_writer_explains_rank: The frozen-pattern value-weight term has cosine at least 0.95 with the exact removed Q8 coefficient vectors and relative RMSE at most 0.25 in both panels.
predictions.pred_d_pattern_terms_are_secondary: Pattern plus interaction residual norm is at most 25% of exact removed Q8 coefficient norm in both panels.
predictions.pred_e_composed_margin_prediction_is_acc: Upstream weight-writer coordinates contracted with the analytic downstream reader predict the corresponding exact H3-rank8 margin effect with cosine at least 0.90 and relative RMSE at most 0.35 in both panels.

decision: All predicates close an explicit L9-triple -> H3-Q8 -> residual modes -> final-reader tensor program. A value failure with exact factor closure redirects to attention-pattern computation; a causal-removal failure means the v8 upstream edge does not transfer to v10 and blocks weight interpretation.
